identitySearch.comparison: For tracks with at least five survey observations within 30 seconds of a GPS.json fix, the smallest median separation was about 2.31 km (Hannon; 25 pairs). No track was close enough to support a candidate identity. This is a coarse screening, not a formal identity determination.

provenance.method: Parse array literals as data without executing JavaScript. Preserve source UTC strings and coordinate precision. Sort by UTC. Exclude missing or obviously out-of-region coordinates; retain their original values in this provenance record. Merge repeated timestamp/coordinate observations; preserve conflicting camera bearings as candidates and set the single bearing to null.
